about_the_game:
When I woke up, I found myself transported to an alternate universe. Facing all kinds of girls, how should I make a choice?

This is a story of love with a plot twist. In the game, you not only need to maintain your favorable impression of each girl, but also have to figure out the hidden secrets behind them.

Be cautious of those girls who have an inexplicable fondness for you, for perhaps there are secrets behind their affection that are unknown to others.

At the same time, you also need to find the girl who truly devoted herself to you behind the scenes, and together with her, you should escape from this situation.





We are planning to release a demo version of the new product for the upcoming festival. We sincerely welcome your diverse opinions.





Production team

Producer: Youyouzi

Art: Gao Xiaohua

Program: Chi Yue

System: Flow Song

short_description: A text adventure game in first-person perspective, with the protagonist being male. You need to uncover the truth by having conversations with various cute girls. Trigger different events through options and finally choose the ending that suits you.
